learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how tiny things come together to make very big things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A single drop of water is small, but many drops together make a huge ocean.
Tiny grains of sand come together to make the beautiful land and beaches.
Even the smallest things are important because they build something wonderful together.

fun_activity.title: 💧 Water Dropper Fun
fun_activity.instructions: Take a spoon or a dropper and count how many drops of water it takes to fill a small bottle cap!

quick_recap: ⭐ Tiny drops of water make the mighty ocean.
⭐ Small grains of sand make the vast land.
⭐ Every little thing is special and important.
